  ## Dream, Design, Deliver
  
  We know that how we deliver is just as important as what we deliver. We’re committed to operating
  safely, ethically, and sustainably across everything we do, and to offering best-in-class
  solutions to optimize for cost, schedule, and performance.
  
  [How We Deliver][34]
  
  ## Additional Info
  
  
  ## Engineering
  
  Our engineers combine collaborative design, ingenuity, and data-centered execution to produce the
  world’s most iconic projects.
  
  [Read More][35]
  [BEO Worker inspecting pipes]
  
  
  ## Procurement
  
  We guarantee the responsible purchase and safe delivery of materials on time, at the best value,
  and from reliable, reputable supplier
  
  [Read More][36]
  [Craft workers assemble a motorway guardrail.]
  
  
  ## Construction
  
  We build extraordinary projects in the world’s most complex environments, expertly navigating
  logistics, local laws, and workforce demands.
  
  [Read More][37]
  
  
  ## Project Management
  
  We apply our industry knowledge and experience as an EPC contractor to ensure safety, quality, and
  efficacy at every stage of your project.
  
  [Read More][38]
  
  
  ## Our Services
  
  Leveraging our full-scale scale project capabilities, we deploy horizontal and vertical
  integration strategies to optimize project delivery — whether managing the entire project
  lifecycle or a single phase.
  
  [Read More][39]
  
  
  ## Safety
  
  Nothing is more important than the safety of our colleagues. We are steadfast in our commitment to
  ensuring that everyone, everywhere, returns home safely at the end of each day.
  
  [Read More][40]
  
  
  ## Quality
  
  We reinforce the highest quality standards through accountability, continuous training, and close
  collaboration with customers.
  
  [Read More][41]
  
  
  ## Ethics
  
  With integrity and fairness at the heart of our operations, we are committed to the highest
  standards of ethical business conduct.
  
  [Read More][42]
  
  
  ## Sustainability
  
  We implement sustainable practices to provide clean energy solutions, decarbonize infrastructure,
  and safeguard against environmental threats, making a positive impact on the world.
  
  [Read More][43]
  
  
  ## Communities
  
  We’re committed to supporting the communities where we live and work.
  
  [Read More][44]
* Careers
  
  ## Building Tomorrow Together
  
  Within Bechtel, you’ll find a world of possibility. As a global company with a reputation for
  taking on generation-defining projects, we provide unparalleled learning and growth opportunities.
  From engineers and project managers to skilled craft professionals and construction experts, we
  seek colleagues who are eager to make their mark on the world.
  
  [Join Our Team][45]
  [Crew member scanning an item at Bechtel Equipment Operations (BEO)]
  
  
  ## Career Opportunities
  
  Are you driven by purpose, thrive on a team, and live for a challenge? Check out our job openings
  and learn more about joining our team.
  
  [Read More][46]
  
  
  ## Life at Bechtel
  
  We work every day to foster an environment where every colleague feels empowered, connected, and
  respected.
  
  [Read More][47]

* People
  
  ## Extraordinary Teams
  
  Our ultimate differentiator is the quality of our people — from our skilled craft professionals to
  our engineers and project managers. We excel at fielding A-teams whose skills and expertise are
  tailored to each project’s specific demands.
  
  [Get to Know Our People][3]
  [construction worker with the sunlight & sky behind him]
  
  
  ## Vision, Values & Commitments
  
  Our VV&Cs are foundational to Bechtel’s culture. They guide our actions and serve as a commitment
  to our customers, colleagues, partners, and neighbors to always do the right thing.
  
  [Read More][4]
  
  
  ## Leadership
  
  Our leadership team is united in their commitment to driving progress and excellence. They guide
  the company with a focus on delivering value to our customers and communities and making Bechtel
  the best place to work.
  
  [Read More][5]
  
  
  ## bechtel.org
  
  bechtel.org serves as the impact infrastructure arm of Bechtel Corporation, delivering scalable
  and sustainable projects in communities with the greatest need. These projects provide our teams
  with valuable experience to grow and excel.
  
  [Read More][6]

* Approach
  
  ## Dream, Design, Deliver
  
  We know that how we deliver is just as important as what we deliver. We’re committed to operating
  safely, ethically, and sustainably across everything we do, and to offering best-in-class
  solutions to optimize for cost, schedule, and performance.
  
  [How We Deliver][34]
  
  ## Additional Info
  
  
  ## Engineering
  
  Our engineers combine collaborative design, ingenuity, and data-centered execution to produce the
  world’s most iconic projects.
  
  [Read More][35]
  [BEO Worker inspecting pipes]
  
  
  ## Procurement
  
  We guarantee the responsible purchase and safe delivery of materials on time, at the best value,
  and from reliable, reputable supplier
  
  [Read More][36]
  [Craft workers assemble a motorway guardrail.]
  
  
  ## Construction
  
  We build extraordinary projects in the world’s most complex environments, expertly navigating
  logistics, local laws, and workforce demands.
  
  [Read More][37]
  
  
  ## Project Management
  
  We apply our industry knowledge and experience as an EPC contractor to ensure safety, quality, and
  efficacy at every stage of your project.
  
  [Read More][38]
  
  
  ## Our Services
  
  Leveraging our full-scale scale project capabilities, we deploy horizontal and vertical
  integration strategies to optimize project delivery — whether managing the entire project
  lifecycle or a single phase.
  
  [Read More][39]
  
  
  ## Safety
  
  Nothing is more important than the safety of our colleagues. We are steadfast in our commitment to
  ensuring that everyone, everywhere, returns home safely at the end of each day.
  
  [Read More][40]
  
  
  ## Quality
  
  We reinforce the highest quality standards through accountability, continuous training, and close
  collaboration with customers.
  
  [Read More][41]
  
  
  ## Ethics
  
  With integrity and fairness at the heart of our operations, we are committed to the highest
  standards of ethical business conduct.
  
  [Read More][42]
  
  
  ## Sustainability
  
  We implement sustainable practices to provide clean energy solutions, decarbonize infrastructure,
  and safeguard against environmental threats, making a positive impact on the world.
  
  [Read More][43]
  
  
  ## Communities
  
  We’re committed to supporting the communities where we live and work.
  
  [Read More][44]
* Careers
  
  ## Building Tomorrow Together
  
  Within Bechtel, you’ll find a world of possibility. As a global company with a reputation for
  taking on generation-defining projects, we provide unparalleled learning and growth opportunities.
  From engineers and project managers to skilled craft professionals and construction experts, we
  seek colleagues who are eager to make their mark on the world.
  
  [Join Our Team][45]
  [Crew member scanning an item at Bechtel Equipment Operations (BEO)]
  
  
  ## Career Opportunities
  
  Are you driven by purpose, thrive on a team, and live for a challenge? Check out our job openings
  and learn more about joining our team.
  
  [Read More][46]
  
  
  ## Life at Bechtel
  
  We work every day to foster an environment where every colleague feels empowered, connected, and
  respected.
  
  [Read More][47]
  [A group of field engineers meets during a walkdown of the Hydrolysate Storage Area.]

  Our colleagues around the world share why they chose to build their careers with Bechtel.

### Groupe

ENGIE est un acteur majeur de la transition énergétique dont la raison d’être est d’agir pour
accélérer la transition vers une économie neutre en carbone. Présent dans 30 pays avec plus de
90 000 collaborateurs, ENGIE couvre toute la chaîne de valeur de l’énergie.

[ chevron_right Découvrir ENGIE ][32]

[ chevron_right Poser une question à EVA ][43]
Recommandée par ENGIE Virtual Assistant

Grâce à son portefeuille d’activités complémentaires, ENGIE couvre l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur
énergétique (production renouvelable et flexibilité, infrastructures, fourniture aux clients).

## [Our global organization][123]

ExxonMobil's three primary businesses provide products that enable modern life, including energy,
chemicals, lubricants, and lower-emissions technologies. We have an industry-leading portfolio of
resources, and we're one of the largest integrated fuels, lubricants and chemical companies in the
world.
* [Liza Destiny FPSO with sunset in background]
  
  ### Upstream
  
  Focused on strengthening energy security by expanding low-cost-of-supply, high-return oil and
  natural gas operations.
  
  [Learn more about our Upstream business][124]
* [Female engineer working in Baytown Technology and Engineering Complex]
  
  ### Product Solutions
  
  Integrating our downstream and chemical operations to develop lower-emission fuels and innovative
  products critical to modern society.
  
  [Learn more about our Downstream business][125]
  [Learn more about our Chemical business][126]
* [Scientist working in a lab]
  
  ### Low Carbon Solutions
  
  Helping reduce emissions by providing solutions to our industrial and commercial customers in
  growing markets for carbon capture and storage, hydrogen and biofuels.
  
  [Learn more about our Low Carbon Solutions business][127]

## Our global brands

ExxonMobil manages an industry-leading portfolio of resources, and is one of the largest integrated
fuels, lubricants and chemical companies in the world. We’ve evolved our operating model and global
organization to better leverage the scale of our increasingly integrated company and global brands.

## About Fluor

Through our people, projects and partnerships, Fluor connects businesses and communities to advance
economies and employment. We create choice and opportunity on a local and global scale.

Building a better world is our purpose. We care deeply about safety and seek to drive quality and
efficiency in all that we do. We behave **ethically**, inclusively and responsibly for a brighter
future.

We support our clients in solving critical challenges. We operate throughout the project lifecycle,
from conceptual design, engineering, procurement and construction to the operations and maintenance
of facilities.

Clients, partners and communities trust Fluor because we are here for the long term – delivering
successful projects of both scale and significance for more than a century. From the spark of an
idea to a project's completion, our nearly 27,000 colleagues in more than 60 locations around the
globe provide professional and technical solutions with world-class expertise.

#### Urban Solutions

industrial operations and maintenance.

][34][

#### Mission Solutions

Helping the U.S. and select international governments solve critical challenges around national
security, nuclear technology and emergency response and recovery.

][35]

## About Fluor

Through our people, projects and partnerships, Fluor connects businesses and communities to advance
economies and employment. We create choice and opportunity on a local and global scale.

Building a better world is our purpose. We care deeply about safety and seek to drive quality and
efficiency in all that we do. We behave **ethically**, inclusively and responsibly for a brighter
future.

We support our clients in solving critical challenges. We operate throughout the project lifecycle,
from conceptual design, engineering, procurement and construction to the operations and maintenance
of facilities.

Clients, partners and communities trust Fluor because we are here for the long term – delivering
successful projects of both scale and significance for more than a century. From the spark of an
idea to a project's completion, our nearly 27,000 colleagues in more than 60 locations around the
globe provide professional and technical solutions with world-class expertise.

# Highlights

Discover what's happening around PETRONAS.

[Legacy Beneath the Waves]

## Legacy Beneath the Waves

PETRONAS is dedicated to preserving marine ecosystems through pioneering initiatives such as
Rigs-to-Reef and Tubular-to-Reef, which repurpose decommissioned offshore structures into
flourishing artificial reefs. These efforts have significantly boosted biodiversity, supported
coastal livelihoods, and aligned with the United Nations' "Life Below Water" goals. By combining
innovation, strategic partnerships, and sustainability, PETRONAS is driving positive change for
Malaysia’s coastal communities and marine life, creating a legacy of thriving oceans for future
generations.

[

Read more

][148]
[The Spirit of Gresik]

## The Spirit of Gresik

Explore how PETRONAS is empowering communities and revitalising ecosystems in Gresik, East Java,
through initiatives like Batik Damar Rukun and mangrove restoration. 

[

Learn more

][149]
[Meet Our Women Trailblazers in Technology]

## Meet Our Women Trailblazers in Technology

PETRONAS has been a cornerstone in the energy industry, driving innovation and progress. A large
part of its success story is owed to the invaluable contributions of the women who have shaped its
trajectory. As PETRONAS celebrates its 50th anniversary, now is a fitting moment to shine a
spotlight on these trailblazers. Here are their stories.

[

Read more

][150]
[PETRONAS Trackside Fluid Engineers Fuelling Formula One’s Innovation]

## PETRONAS Trackside Fluid Engineers Fuelling Formula One’s Innovation

In the fast-paced world of Formula One where split milliseconds define success, the role of
trackside engineers has never been more crucial. Among these unsung heroes are Wan Mohd Saifullah
Wan Saudi and Emil Bernsten, two PETRONAS Trackside Fluid Engineers (PTFE), whose journey from
diverse backgrounds to the most prestigious motorsport track exemplifies the spirit of
collaboration, innovation, and excellence.

[

Read more

[Majlis Sekalung Budi 2025: The Story of Us]

## Majlis Sekalung Budi 2025: The Story of Us

At PETRONAS, every achievement is shaped by the people who give their best, year after year. We
honour our long-serving colleagues and retirees for the time, effort, and experience they have
shared with us. Thank you for helping build the journey we continue today.

# Highlights

Discover what's happening around PETRONAS.

[Legacy Beneath the Waves]

## Legacy Beneath the Waves

PETRONAS is dedicated to preserving marine ecosystems through pioneering initiatives such as
Rigs-to-Reef and Tubular-to-Reef, which repurpose decommissioned offshore structures into
flourishing artificial reefs. These efforts have significantly boosted biodiversity, supported
coastal livelihoods, and aligned with the United Nations' "Life Below Water" goals. By combining
innovation, strategic partnerships, and sustainability, PETRONAS is driving positive change for
Malaysia’s coastal communities and marine life, creating a legacy of thriving oceans for future
generations.

[

Read more

][148]
[The Spirit of Gresik]

## The Spirit of Gresik

Explore how PETRONAS is empowering communities and revitalising ecosystems in Gresik, East Java,
through initiatives like Batik Damar Rukun and mangrove restoration. 

[

Learn more

[Meet Our Women Trailblazers in Technology]

## Meet Our Women Trailblazers in Technology

PETRONAS has been a cornerstone in the energy industry, driving innovation and progress. A large
part of its success story is owed to the invaluable contributions of the women who have shaped its
trajectory. As PETRONAS celebrates its 50th anniversary, now is a fitting moment to shine a
spotlight on these trailblazers. Here are their stories.

Read more

[PETRONAS Trackside Fluid Engineers Fuelling Formula One’s Innovation]

## PETRONAS Trackside Fluid Engineers Fuelling Formula One’s Innovation

In the fast-paced world of Formula One where split milliseconds define success, the role of
trackside engineers has never been more crucial. Among these unsung heroes are Wan Mohd Saifullah
Wan Saudi and Emil Bernsten, two PETRONAS Trackside Fluid Engineers (PTFE), whose journey from
diverse backgrounds to the most prestigious motorsport track exemplifies the spirit of
collaboration, innovation, and excellence.

At PETRONAS, every achievement is shaped by the people who give their best, year after year. We
honour our long-serving colleagues and retirees for the time, effort, and experience they have
shared with us. Thank you for helping build the journey we continue today.

  Our Operations
  
  Our extensive onshore and offshore operations produce a full range of valuable gas products. We
  maintain a constant focus on operational excellence, asset reliability and HSE performance.
  
  Our Operations>Gas Processing
  
  Operating at the heart of the UAE’s hydrocarbon value chain, we receive feed gas from ADNOC’s
  onshore and offshore production operations, and produce a mixture of sales gas, NGLs, condensate
  and sulfur to serve our downstream customers.
  
  Our Operations>LNG Operations
  
  Our liquefaction facilities supply LNG from gas produced in ADNOC’s offshore operations for export
  to utilities and industrial customers around the globe.
  
  Our Operations>Pipeline Network
  
  Our extensive 3,260km gas pipeline network enables delivery of sales gas to customers across Abu
  Dhabi, Dubai and the Northern Emirates, meeting ~60 % of UAE’s gas requirements
  
  Our Operations>Industrial Gases
  
  We are one of the UAE’s major suppliers of industrial gases, primarily nitrogen and oxygen.
  
  Our Operations>Other Products
  
  We produce several other associated products, primarily for use in the chemicals sector by
  customers both in the UAE and overseas.

  Sustainability
  
  We apply a determined focus on sustainability across our business.
  
  Sustainability>Environment
  
  We have developed a robust road map of projects to accelerate significant advances in our
  environmental performance that delivered a 10% reduction in our GHG emissions (2021 vs 2018
  baseline).
  
  Sustainability>Health & Safety
  
  We maintain an unwavering focus on health and safety and are continually striving to drive our
  first quartile performance towards our ultimate goal of ensuring ‘100% HSE’ - keeping our
  employees, communities, the environment and assets safe from harm.
  
  Sustainability>UAE Growth
  
  We act as a powerful catalyst to driving the UAE’s economic development and diversification,
  providing energy and other gas products vital to UAE industry, and ensuring a strong in-country
  value contribution from our operations.
  
  Sustainability>Social Responsibility
  
  In alignment with ADNOC Group, we manage our operations to make a positive contribution to the
  development of our society and the communities in which we operate.

  * [IGD-E2][25]
  Projects
  
  We continue to invest in and develop our gas and LNG processing, transmission and export
  infrastructure, expanding capacity and connectivity, and driving efficiency and sustainability.
  
  Projects>Ruwais LNG
  
  The first LNG export facility in the MENA region to run on clean power. Producing 9.6 million tons
  of LNG per year providing access to reliable and affordable energy.
  
  Projects>IGD-E2
  
  ADNOC Gas continues to invest to increase gas processing capacity and further integrate its
  onshore and offshore facilities. A key component of this program has been the Integrated Gas
  Development project and its subsequent extension phases.

  Innovation and technology are core to our operations. We are transforming our business, deploying
  cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and digital solutions to manage our
  operations more efficiently, safely and sustainably.
  
  ENERGYai>3D printing
  
  ADNOC Gas is utilizing additive manufacturing (3D-printing) at a number of sites to simplify

# ADNOC Gas

## One of the World’s Largest Integrated Gas Companies

ADNOC Gas is a large-scale, integrated gas processing company and a subsidiary of ADNOC, one of the
world's largest integrated energy companies.

As a leading global gas player with access to capacity of around 10 billion standard cubic feet of
gas per day (bscfd), we serve a wide range of domestic and international customers with an expanding
portfolio of products. We supply around 60% of the UAE’s gas needs and export natural gas and
related products to a diverse customer base in over 20 countries.

## Our Company

ADNOC Gas is a world-class integrated gas company operating an unmatched asset base that supplies
around 60% of the UAE's natural gas requirements and serves customers in more than 20 countries.

[Our Company][69]


### Our Operations

Our extensive onshore and offshore operations produce a full range of valuable gas products. We
maintain a constant focus on operational excellence, asset reliability and HSE performance.

[Explore][70]

### Sustainability

We apply a determined focus on sustainability across our business.

[Explore][71]

### Our Projects

We continue to invest in and develop our gas and LNG processing, transmission and export
infrastructure, expanding capacity and connectivity, and driving efficiency and sustainability.

[Explore][72]

### Innovation

Innovation and technology are core to our operations. We are transforming our business, deploying
cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and digital solutions to manage our
operations more efficiently, safely and sustainably.

[Explore][73]

### Marketing

We currently export LNG and other gas products to more than 20 countries and are strategically
situated to serve the primary international growth markets in Asia.

[Explore][74]

## Investor Relations

On 13 March 2023, ADNOC Gas successfully commenced trading on ADX. Read more about our financial
profile as we capitalize on growing demand for natural gas and the UAE’s significant investments in
the energy sector.

The Services business segment delivers marine and onshore services including terminal operations,

[Explore][40]

#### Captain Abdulkareem Al Masabi

“As a global energy maritime logistics leader, ADNOC L&S provides world-class Integrated Logistics,
Shipping and Services capabilities to more than 100 customers in over 50 countries.  Through our
transformational growth strategy, we are building a business of scale that unlocks new value for
customers, shareholders, and the UAE through efficient and diversified operations, a commitment to
technological innovation, a 100% HSE culture and a sustainability journey that contributes to the
UAE's ambition to achieve net-zero emissions by 2050 and progress towards the IMO 2050 requirements
for shipping to hit net-zero.”

[Leadership][41]

## ESG

At ADNOC L&S, ESG is a core operational and strategic priority. As a leading provider of maritime
logistics and services, we maintain a deeply rooted connection to the nation’s rich seafaring
maritime heritage and sustainability is deeply held within the DNA of our company. We are fully
aligned with the International Maritime Organization strategy for greenhouse gas emissions and are
making major contributions to ADNOC Group’s 2045 Net Zero target and the UAE’s Net Zero 2050
strategy. Since 2023, we have committed $6.25 billion toward LNG carriers and dual-fuel vessels,
driving significant improvements in fleet energy efficiency and supporting our emissions reduction
goals and reduced the carbon intensity of our shipping operations by 56% since 2019.

### What We Do


ADNOC L&S is a fully integrated global energy maritime logistics leader that operates onshore and
offshore energy-related logistics activities, including international energy transportation, for
more than 100 customers in over 50 countries with offices in 19 cities. 

With a total fleet of 340+ owned vessels and an additional 600+ chartered every year, a talent base
of over 11,500 people and a steadfast commitment to decarbonization and technological innovation,
ADNOC L&S offers secure, dependable, and efficient maritime and logistics solutions across the
entire energy value chain.

## ADNOC L&S Business Units

### Integrated Logistics

The Integrated Logistics business segment provides comprehensive offshore logistics solutions,
including the transportation of people, materials, equipment, fuel and water. The business segment
also provides diving support, support base and shoreside support services, and materials handling
and storage.

[Explore][38]

### Shipping

The Shipping business segment offers commercial shipping solutions for the transportation of energy
and related products such as crude oil, refined products, Liquefied Natural Gas and Liquefied
Petroleum Gas.

[Explore][39]

### Services

The Services business segment delivers marine and onshore services including terminal operations,
warehousing and onshore materials handling, maritime traffic management, petroleum ports operations,
oil spill and HNS response, commercial pools management, ship management and bunkering.

[Explore][40]

#### Captain Abdulkareem Al Masabi

“As a global energy maritime logistics leader, ADNOC L&S provides world-class Integrated Logistics,
Shipping and Services capabilities to more than 100 customers in over 50 countries.  Through our
transformational growth strategy, we are building a business of scale that unlocks new value for
customers, shareholders, and the UAE through efficient and diversified operations, a commitment to
technological innovation, a 100% HSE culture and a sustainability journey that contributes to the
UAE's ambition to achieve net-zero emissions by 2050 and progress towards the IMO 2050 requirements
for shipping to hit net-zero.”

[Leadership][41]

## ESG

At ADNOC L&S, ESG is a core operational and strategic priority. As a leading provider of maritime
logistics and services, we maintain a deeply rooted connection to the nation’s rich seafaring
maritime heritage and sustainability is deeply held within the DNA of our company. We are fully
aligned with the International Maritime Organization strategy for greenhouse gas emissions and are
making major contributions to ADNOC Group’s 2045 Net Zero target and the UAE’s Net Zero 2050
strategy. Since 2023, we have committed $6.25 billion toward LNG carriers and dual-fuel vessels,
driving significant improvements in fleet energy efficiency and supporting our emissions reduction
goals and reduced the carbon intensity of our shipping operations by 56% since 2019.

# Broadview Energy Solutions B.V.


## LNG distribution strategy

Broadview aims to expand and strengthen its current position in the small scale LNG (distribution)
market through organic growth of the existing portfolio companies as well as through new
acquisitions and investments.

## Small scale LNG portfolio

Within the LNG market, Broadview is active through its participations in Aritas Cryogenics, Barents
Naturgass, Cryogenic Container Solutions and DMT Environmental Technology. Key markets for
distributed LNG are off-grid industry, remote power generation and marine fuel. Distribution is done
by LNG trailers as well as by 40ft ISO containers.

# Why choose us
* LNG distributor in Europe by road
* Experience in industry, transport and marine
* One-stop-shop including engineering, commodity and transport
* European coverage with supplies
* Solid group also offering financing solutions

# Delivering U.S. Liquefied Natural Gas to Customers around the World

Cameron LNG was developed to meet the growing demand for energy around the world with three
liquefaction trains to safely process and load LNG supplies onto ships. Cameron LNG’s partners,
Sempra Infrastructure, Mitsui & Co., Mitsubishi Corporation, TotalEnergies, and NYK Line, represent
extensive LNG market and shipping experience and are committed to achieving operational excellence
to ensure safe and reliable workplace.

# Our Cameron LNG Vision

Cameron LNG’s vision is to provide safe, efficient and cost-effective natural gas liquefaction and
regasification services for our partners, their customers and the communities that depend on energy
reliability and security.

# Local Roots with a Global Reach

Cameron LNG’s namesake originates from Cameron Parish, known for its many lakes, wildlife refuges
and natural beauty. Located in Hackberry, Louisiana, Cameron LNG was developed from a regasification
facility in 2011 to provide global markets with direct access to LNG supplies on the deep-water
Calcasieu ship channel. More than 200 Cameron LNG employees are working to safely transform natural
gas to LNG. We have made a commitment to safeguard the area wildlife and marshlands, support our
community and work with local businesses and schools to improve our quality of life.

# Delivering U.S. Liquefied Natural Gas to Customers around the World

Cameron LNG was developed to meet the growing demand for energy around the world with three
liquefaction trains to safely process and load LNG supplies onto ships. Cameron LNG’s partners,
Sempra Infrastructure, Mitsui & Co., Mitsubishi Corporation, TotalEnergies, and NYK Line, represent
extensive LNG market and shipping experience and are committed to achieving operational excellence
to ensure safe and reliable workplace.

# Our Cameron LNG Vision

Cameron LNG’s vision is to provide safe, efficient and cost-effective natural gas liquefaction and
regasification services for our partners, their customers and the communities that depend on energy
reliability and security.

# Local Roots with a Global Reach

Cameron LNG’s namesake originates from Cameron Parish, known for its many lakes, wildlife refuges
and natural beauty. Located in Hackberry, Louisiana, Cameron LNG was developed from a regasification
facility in 2011 to provide global markets with direct access to LNG supplies on the deep-water
Calcasieu ship channel. More than 200 Cameron LNG employees are working to safely transform natural
gas to LNG. We have made a commitment to safeguard the area wildlife and marshlands, support our
community and work with local businesses and schools to improve our quality of life.

# About Chart Industries

Chart Industries (NYSE: GTLS) is a leading global manufacturer of highly engineered equipment
servicing multiple applications in the clean energy and industrial gas markets. Our unique product
portfolio is used in every phase of the liquid gas supply chain, including upfront engineering,
service and repair.

### Qatar

ConocoPhillips holds interest in Qatargas 3, a large-scale LNG liquefaction and export project
operated by Qatar Petroleum and located in Ras Laffan Industrial City, Qatar.
[ Europe, Middle East & Africa highlights ][118]

### Alaska

ConocoPhillips Alaska, Inc. (CPAI) is Alaska’s largest crude oil producer and largest owner of
exploration leases, with approximately 1 million net undeveloped acres at year-end 2023.
[ Alaska highlights ][119]
[Surmont photo]

### Canada

The ConocoPhillips Canadian operations are comprised primarily of Surmont in the Athabasca region of
northeastern Alberta and the Montney unconventional development in British Columbia.
[ Canada highlights ][120]
[photo of Permian operations]
Exploration & Production

### Lower 48

The Lower 48 represents the largest ConocoPhillips business segment today based on production, with
high-quality positions in the U.S. unconventionals. These durable, low cost of supply and low
GHG-intensity assets have significant upside potential.
[ Lower 48 highlights ][121]

ConocoPhillips has been active in Australia for two decades and serves as operator of the Australia

Exploration & Production

We have varying stages of oil and gas exploration, development and production activities in

the Alba Unit located offshore Equatorial Guinea.

# Home

## Worldwide Logistics, Government, Marine and Energy Solutions

**People who know Crowley, know our employees are among the most knowledgeable and customer-focused
in the industries we serve. They appreciate that we go places and solve problems others can’t. That
we simplify the complex and make the routine more efficient. And, that we are committed to the
success of their mission, project or supply chain. We invite you to explore our website and let us
know how we may be of service.**

[Our Company][59]
[Our Culture][60]
[JOIN OUR TEAM][61]

**Complete End-to-End Supply Chain Services in the **
**United States, the Caribbean Basin, Central America,**
** and Beyond**

[Crowley Fuels]

**Transportation, Distribution, and Sales of Petroleum and
Fuel Products to More Than 160 Communities
Throughout the state of Alaska.**

[Crowley Wind]

## [Wind Services][64]

**Support for Offshore Wind, including Construction & Installation Solutions, Terminals, Marine

[Crowley Shipping]

## [Shipping][65]

**Services for Maritime and Offshore Sectors, including Design, Engineering, Construction and

## [Land Transportation][66]

**Blended asset and non-asset based multimodal land transportation solutions including brokerage,
trucking, drayage, managed transportation and intermodal services.**

[Crowley Solutions]

## [Government Services][67]

**Government Services – Maritime, Supply Chain and Freight Transportation Management, Expeditionary
Logistics, Technology and Energy Solutions**

## **People Who Care**

**From supporting academic achievement and providing hands-on assistance to those in need, to
helping current and former military personnel transition into the maritime industry, Crowley is
committed to the communities where we work.**

[Crowley Cares][68]
[Scholarships][69]
[Sustainability][70]
[For Veterans][71]

#### **Crowley Mariners Honored with Gallant Ship Award on National Maritime Day**

Crowley mariners who served aboard the U.S.-flagged tanker Stena Immaculate were honored with the
U.S. Maritime Administration’s (MARAD) Gallant Ship Award during the U.S. Department of
Transportation’s National Maritime Day observance in Washington, D.C. The award, one of the maritime
industry’s highest distinctions, recognizes the 23-member crew’s extraordinary professionalism,
courage and commitment to safety.

[Read the Full press Release>][72]

#### **Crowley’s First Avance Class Vessel Quetzal Begins Maiden Commercial Voyage**

Crowley’s new LNG-powered containership Quetzal has successfully begun its inaugural commercial
voyage, opening the company’s next era of faster, frequent ocean shipping with a new class of
vessels for the U.S., Central America and the Dominican Republic.

With capacity for up to 1,400 20-foot container equivalent units (TEUs), Quetzal and its three
forthcoming sister Avance Class ships will provide more cargo capacity while using lower-emissions
liquefied natural gas (LNG) for fuel. Quetzal and its sister ships were specifically designed to
accommodate a variety of container sizes, including 300 refrigerated container unit plugs.

[Read More >][73]

# Home

## Worldwide Logistics, Government, Marine and Energy Solutions

**People who know Crowley, know our employees are among the most knowledgeable and customer-focused
in the industries we serve. They appreciate that we go places and solve problems others can’t. That
we simplify the complex and make the routine more efficient. And, that we are committed to the
success of their mission, project or supply chain. We invite you to explore our website and let us
know how we may be of service.**

[Our Company][59]
[Our Culture][60]
[JOIN OUR TEAM][61]

**United States, the Caribbean Basin, Central America,**
** and Beyond**

**Transportation, Distribution, and Sales of Petroleum and
Fuel Products to More Than 160 Communities
Throughout the state of Alaska.**

**Support for Offshore Wind, including Construction & Installation Solutions, Terminals, Marine

## [Shipping][65]

**Services for Maritime and Offshore Sectors, including Design, Engineering, Construction and
Operations; Petroleum Transportation, and Ship Assist **

## [Land Transportation][66]

**Blended asset and non-asset based multimodal land transportation solutions including brokerage,
trucking, drayage, managed transportation and intermodal services.**

[Crowley Solutions]

## [Government Services][67]

**Government Services – Maritime, Supply Chain and Freight Transportation Management, Expeditionary
Logistics, Technology and Energy Solutions**

## **People Who Care**

**From supporting academic achievement and providing hands-on assistance to those in need, to
helping current and former military personnel transition into the maritime industry, Crowley is
committed to the communities where we work.**

[Crowley Cares][68]
[Scholarships][69]
[Sustainability][70]
[For Veterans][71]

#### **Crowley Mariners Honored with Gallant Ship Award on National Maritime Day**

Crowley mariners who served aboard the U.S.-flagged tanker Stena Immaculate were honored with the
U.S. Maritime Administration’s (MARAD) Gallant Ship Award during the U.S. Department of
Transportation’s National Maritime Day observance in Washington, D.C. The award, one of the maritime
industry’s highest distinctions, recognizes the 23-member crew’s extraordinary professionalism,
courage and commitment to safety.

[Read the Full press Release>][72]

#### **Crowley’s First Avance Class Vessel Quetzal Begins Maiden Commercial Voyage**

Crowley’s new LNG-powered containership Quetzal has successfully begun its inaugural commercial
voyage, opening the company’s next era of faster, frequent ocean shipping with a new class of
vessels for the U.S., Central America and the Dominican Republic.

With capacity for up to 1,400 20-foot container equivalent units (TEUs), Quetzal and its three
forthcoming sister Avance Class ships will provide more cargo capacity while using lower-emissions
liquefied natural gas (LNG) for fuel. Quetzal and its sister ships were specifically designed to
accommodate a variety of container sizes, including 300 refrigerated container unit plugs.

[Read More >][73]

## North America’s Largest Private,
## Vertically Integrated LNG Provider

Cryopeak offers holistic LNG energy supply and distribution through our end-to-end mobile gas
network and fully integrated natural gas value chains. By partnering with leading equipment and
storage technology providers, Cryopeak designs and installs modular, turnkey systems tailored to
each application, enabling reliable, flexible LNG deployment across multiple end markets, including
LNG on-site storage and vaporization solutions.

 

Driven by technical expertise and continuous innovation, Cryopeak helps clients reduce emissions
while advancing their transition to lower-carbon fuels. From our virtual pipelines to our customized
system design, our solutions are built to exceed today’s demands while building a more sustainable
energy future.

[ ABOUT US ][44]
[LNG Provider][LNG Provider]

SOLUTIONS

## LNG Solutions

### Technologies

Our support doesn’t end with LNG fuel supply. Cryopeak helps you adapt new and existing equipment to
excel in evolving markets, service demands, and vendor landscapes, all while reducing emissions and
operational costs.

[ Learn More ][45]

### LNG Fuels

Seamlessly transition energy sources and improve environmental outcomes. Virtual pipelines, on-site
storage, and custom regasification systems ensure your operational needs are covered as you explore
alternate energy sources.

[ Learn More ][46]

### Services

Cryopeak offers reliable low-carbon logistics and engineering backed by decades of in-field
experience. From project planning and device monitoring to mobile applications and field service, we
are proud to support low-carbon technology across North America.

[ Learn More ][47]

The Advantage of LNG

## Leading the Way
## in Low Emissions

Cryopeak is one service provider with infinite applications. Our decades of experience and vertical
integration allow us to design and implement proactive energy architecture that supports
low-emission goals and continuity for your complex grid-parallel and off-grid operations. Secure
carbon emission reductions of up to 35% through LNG and customized on-site systems, tailored to your
needs, environment, and existing infrastructure.

## What is the purpose of an oil storage terminal?

An oil storage terminal serves as a secure facility for storing petroleum, crude oil, and refined
products before transportation to refineries, distributors, or end-users. These terminals ensure
safe handling, regulated storage, and efficient distribution, meeting both environmental and
operational standards. They are a critical link in the petroleum supply chain, supporting stable
fuel availability and strategic reserves.

## How does Edison Oil Company ensure reliable petroleum logistics?

Edison Oil Company works with trusted partners to provide seamless and reliable petroleum logistics.
From storage to transportation, our processes meet stringent safety and quality standards. We
prioritize transparency, timely delivery, and compliance with international regulations. By
collaborating with reputable tank farms and logistics companies, we guarantee efficient and
dependable service for every client, ensuring energy resources are moved safely and responsibly
across all stages of the supply chain.

## What are the benefits of partnering with an ethical oil supply company?

Partnering with an ethical oil supply company like Edison Oil Company ensures socially responsible
operations, environmental compliance, and transparency in every transaction. Clients benefit from
fair pricing, secure storage, and sustainable trading practices. We focus on building long-term
trust with our partners by adhering to global standards, reducing environmental impact, and
promoting ethical sourcing. This approach supports stable energy supplies while safeguarding the
interests of stakeholders, communities, and the environment.

Get in touch with us for inquiries, partnerships, or support. Fill out the contact form, and our

[Clean energy LNG ship in ocean] Who we are

## From Boston to Bangladesh, we're transforming markets with cleaner energy.

As a US LNG company with a global presence, Excelerate Energy is committed to enhancing energy
security and supporting the energy transition. We are changing the way people access clean,
affordable, and reliable energy. Our integrated LNG solutions remove the roadblocks that routinely
hinder gas and power projects in markets across the globe. We are empowering countries with energy
independence.

[ More about us ][21]

## We empower countries with energy security.

With demand for power rapidly growing worldwide, our flexible, fully integrated LNG products allow
customers to safely and efficiently access energy in downstream markets.

## मिशन

## GAIL– Energizing
## Possibilities

GAIL (India) Limited is India’s leading natural gas company, with a robust and diversified presence
across the entire natural gas value chain and beyond. Its operations encompass the transmission and
marketing of Natural Gas, production of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) and other liquid hydrocarbons,
LPG transmission, Polymer production and marketing, City Gas Distribution, LNG sourcing, shipping
and regasification, renewable energy initiatives and upstream exploration and production activities.

[About GAIL][25]

## गेल (इंडिया) लिमिटेड
## संभावनाओं को ऊर्जा

गेल (इंडिया) लिमिटेड भारत की अग्रणी प्राकृतिक गैस कंपनी है, जिसकी संपूर्ण प्राकृतिक गैस मूल्य श्रृंखला और उससे इतर भी एक
मज़बूत और विविध उपस्थिति है । कंपनी की गतिविधियों में प्राकृतिक गैस का परिवहन एवं विपणन, द्रवीकृत पेट्रोलियम गैस
(एलपीजी) तथा अन्य तरल हाइड्रोकार्बनों का उत्पादन, एलपीजी संचरण, पॉलिमर का उत्पादन एवं विपणन, शहरी गैस वितरण,
एलएनजी की सोर्सिंग, शिपिंग एवं रीगैसिफिकेशन, नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा पहलें तथा अपस्ट्रीम अन्वेषण एवं उत्पादन कार्य शामिल हैं ।

## मिशन

## GAIL– Energizing
## Possibilities

GAIL (India) Limited is India’s leading natural gas company, with a robust and diversified presence
across the entire natural gas value chain and beyond. Its operations encompass the transmission and
marketing of Natural Gas, production of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) and other liquid hydrocarbons,
LPG transmission, Polymer production and marketing, City Gas Distribution, LNG sourcing, shipping
and regasification, renewable energy initiatives and upstream exploration and production activities.

## गेल (इंडिया) लिमिटेड
## संभावनाओं को ऊर्जा

गेल (इंडिया) लिमिटेड भारत की अग्रणी प्राकृतिक गैस कंपनी है, जिसकी संपूर्ण प्राकृतिक गैस मूल्य श्रृंखला और उससे इतर भी एक
मज़बूत और विविध उपस्थिति है । कंपनी की गतिविधियों में प्राकृतिक गैस का परिवहन एवं विपणन, द्रवीकृत पेट्रोलियम गैस
(एलपीजी) तथा अन्य तरल हाइड्रोकार्बनों का उत्पादन, एलपीजी संचरण, पॉलिमर का उत्पादन एवं विपणन, शहरी गैस वितरण,
एलएनजी की सोर्सिंग, शिपिंग एवं रीगैसिफिकेशन, नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा पहलें तथा अपस्ट्रीम अन्वेषण एवं उत्पादन कार्य शामिल हैं ।

## Possibilities

GAIL (India) Limited is India’s leading natural gas company, with a robust and diversified presence
across the entire natural gas value chain and beyond. Its operations encompass the transmission and
marketing of Natural Gas, production of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) and other liquid hydrocarbons,
LPG transmission, Polymer production and marketing, City Gas Distribution, LNG sourcing, shipping
and regasification, renewable energy initiatives and upstream exploration and production activities.

## संभावनाओं को ऊर्जा

गेल (इंडिया) लिमिटेड भारत की अग्रणी प्राकृतिक गैस कंपनी है, जिसकी संपूर्ण प्राकृतिक गैस मूल्य श्रृंखला और उससे इतर भी एक

एलएनजी की सोर्सिंग, शिपिंग एवं रीगैसिफिकेशन, नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा पहलें तथा अपस्ट्रीम अन्वेषण एवं उत्पादन कार्य शामिल हैं ।

# [ Specialty Gas Supplier ][69]

Gas Innovations is a leading supplier of specialty gas that offers expertise in high-purity gases
for LNG liquefaction projects for both start-ups and ongoing supply; high-purity hydrocarbons as
diluents, solvents, refrigerants, and co-monomers, as well as for use in producing electronics,
specialty fine chemicals, and pharmaceuticals. Our high-purity gas products consist of [Methane][70]
(CH4), [Ethane][71] (C2H6), [Ethylene][72] (C2H4), [Propane][73] (C3H8), [Propylene][74] (C3H6),
[n-Butane][75] (C4H10), [Isobutane][76] (iso-C4H10), [Butene(s)][77] (1-C4H8) | (cis-2-C4H8)
|(trans-2-C4H8), [Isobutylene][78] (iso-C4H8), [Pentane(s)][79] (C5H12) | (iso-C5H12), Hexane
(C6H14), Hexene (C6H12), Anhydrous Hydrogen Chloride (HCl), [Hydrogen][80] (H2), [Helium][81] (He),
and [Carbon Monoxide][82] (CO). Cryogenic liquids are also offered for [Methane][83] (LNG),
[Ethane][84], and [Ethylene][85].

## Home

Greenville LNG
[Read More ][14] Welcome to
Greenville LNG Greenville Liquefied Natural Gas Company Limited liquefies and markets LNG to power
plants and industrial customers in Nigeria. The company has plans to market LNG to other West
African countries also. [Read More ][15] Storage tanks and LNG-fueled trucks Greenville LNG supplies
Liquefied Natural Gas to any location in the country with company owned fleet of 300 LNG Tanker
Trucks and a network of storage tanks in Nigeria. [Read More ][16] Greenville LNG
Re-fuelling Stations Greenville has a network of LNG refueling stations located at strategic sites
across the country. These facilitate movement of LNG fueled trucks of Greenville. [Read More ][17]
Facilities at Customer Sites Greenville facilitates all customers with LNG regasification facility
consisting on-site storage tanks, regasification equipment and associated facilities at customer
sites.

### 1st to Market
### LNG in Nigeria

### 1st to Supply Gas to
### Northern Nigeria

### 1st to operate Fleet of
### Trucks 100% on LNG

## Our Operations

Greenville offers Liquefied Natural Gas to our customers. We supply LNG at the doorstep of our
customers all year round in a steady manner. Greenville also provides cryogenic storage tanks to the
larger customers so that adequate stocks can be maintained for smooth operations. Greenville is
supplying LNG to customers in remote locations of Nigeria. Our customers are in all regions of
Nigeria. We will commence LNG supplies to other West African countries soon.

## Our Products and Solutions

Greenville LNG not only offers LNG to our customers, but also complete LNG based power solutions. We
play an advisory role to our customers, checking their power and energy requirements, advising them
on appropriate capacities of gas generator/s to be installed, cryogenic storage tank capacities,
flow levels of gas and hence the capacities of vaporisers and other accessories. We also offer
advice on planning for future expansion of capacities of LNG storage and supplies.

#### Customer Locations

Greenville customers are mainly Large Industrial / Manufacturing plants and power plants located
across Nigeria.

[Read More ][21]

#### Gas Hubs

Greenville is establishing numerous Gas Hubs across Nigeria. The Gas Hubs will cater to SMEs and
Autogas in the surrounding areas.

[Read More ][22]

#### Refueling Stations

Greenville has LNG refueling stations at 7 locations in Nigeria. More are being planned.

[Read More ][23]

#### Future Projects

Greenville is participating in various special projects such as supplying LNG to power plants in
Maiduguri and Sokoto.

## about us

Founded in 1992, HL Cryogenics specializes in the design and manufacture of high vacuum insulated
pipe systems and related support equipment for the transfer of liquid nitrogen, liquid oxygen,
liquid argon, liquid hydrogen, liquid helium and LNG.

HL Cryogenics provides turnkey solutions, from R&D and design to manufacturing and after sales,
helping customers enhance system efficiency and reliability. We are proud to be recognized by global
partners including Linde, Air Liquide, Messer, Air Products, and Praxair.

Certified with ASME, CE, and ISO9001, HL Cryogenics is committed to delivering high-quality products
and services across many industries.

We strive to help our customers gain competitive advantages in a rapidly evolving market through
advanced technology, reliability, and cost-effective solutions.

## about us

Founded in 1992, HL Cryogenics specializes in the design and manufacture of high vacuum insulated
pipe systems and related support equipment for the transfer of liquid nitrogen, liquid oxygen,
liquid argon, liquid hydrogen, liquid helium and LNG.

HL Cryogenics provides turnkey solutions, from R&D and design to manufacturing and after sales,
helping customers enhance system efficiency and reliability. We are proud to be recognized by global
partners including Linde, Air Liquide, Messer, Air Products, and Praxair.

Certified with ASME, CE, and ISO9001, HL Cryogenics is committed to delivering high-quality products
and services across many industries.

We strive to help our customers gain competitive advantages in a rapidly evolving market through
advanced technology, reliability, and cost-effective solutions.

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

protection. Our product portfolio includes:

# Liquefied Natural Gas:
# The Global Energy Bridge

A scientific, non-commercial encyclopedia of LNG technology, markets, and infrastructure

-162°C Liquefaction Temperature
600:1 Volume Reduction
~520 MTPA Global Capacity 2026
$3.50 Henry Hub (2026 avg)
[Start Learning][10] [The Process][11]

## What is Liquefied Natural Gas?

LNG is natural gas cooled to -162°C (-260°F), reducing its volume by 600 times for efficient
long-distance transport. Composed primarily of methane (CH4), LNG enables global energy trade
between continents, connecting gas-rich regions with energy-hungry markets.

### The Physics

Natural gas at -162°C becomes liquid, with 85-95% methane plus ethane, propane, and nitrogen. The
energy density enables transoceanic shipping.

[Learn the science →][12]

### The Infrastructure

From liquefaction trains to Q-Max carriers to regasification terminals, LNG requires specialized
cryogenic engineering at every stage.

[Explore technology →][13]

### The Markets

The USA, Qatar, and Australia dominate exports. Asia drives demand. Henry Hub, JKM, and TTF shape
pricing across interconnected global markets.

[View market data →][14]

## LNG by the Numbers

**85-95%** Methane (CH4) composition
**-260°F** Liquefaction temperature (-162°C)
**0.42 g/cm³** LNG density (45% of water)
**5-15%** Flammability range in air
**11.9 Bcf/d** US LNG exports (2024, world's largest)
**40%** Lower CO2 emissions vs. coal

## LNG vs. Pipeline Gas vs. CNG

────────────────┬─────────────────────────┬─────────────────────┬───────────────────────
Property        │LNG (Liquefied)          │Pipeline Gas         │CNG (Compressed)       
────────────────┼─────────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────
Temperature     │-162°C (-260°F)          │Ambient              │Ambient                
────────────────┼─────────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────
Pressure        │~1 bar (atmospheric)     │50-100 bar           │200-250 bar            
────────────────┼─────────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────
Volume Reduction│600:1                    │1:1                  │~200:1                 
────────────────┼─────────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────
Energy Density  │22.2 MJ/L                │0.034 MJ/L (at STP)  │9 MJ/L                 
────────────────┼─────────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────
Transport Method│Cryogenic tankers/trucks │Pipelines            │High-pressure cylinders
────────────────┼─────────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────
Best Use Case   │Intercontinental shipping│Regional distribution│Vehicle fuel, off-grid 
────────────────┴─────────────────────────┴─────────────────────┴───────────────────────

**Key Insight:** LNG's 600:1 volume reduction makes it economically viable for transoceanic trade
where pipelines are impossible. A single Q-Max LNG carrier (266,000 m³) transports the energy
equivalent of 159 million cubic meters of gas at standard conditions.

## Global LNG Trade Flow

In 2026, the USA leads global LNG exports at 11.9 Bcf/d, followed by Australia and Qatar. Major
import regions include Asia (Japan, South Korea, China, India) and Europe (replacing Russian
pipeline gas).

### Top Exporters
1. **[United States][15]** — 11.9 Bcf/d (Sabine Pass, Cameron, Freeport, Golden Pass)
2. **[Australia][16]** — 10.5 Bcf/d (Gorgon, QCLNG, GLNG)
3. **[Qatar][17]** — 10.4 Bcf/d (Ras Laffan, North Field expansion ongoing)
4. **Russia** — 4.4 Bcf/d (Yamal LNG, Sakhalin-2)
5. **Malaysia** — 3.7 Bcf/d (MLNG Tiga, MLNG Dua)

### Top Importers
1. **China** — Post-Zero COVID demand surge
2. **Japan** — Largest historical importer
3. **South Korea** — Heavy industry reliance
4. **India** — Growing consumption
5. **European Union** — Energy security post-Russia

# Liquefied Natural Gas:
# The Global Energy Bridge

A scientific, non-commercial encyclopedia of LNG technology, markets, and infrastructure

-162°C Liquefaction Temperature
600:1 Volume Reduction
~520 MTPA Global Capacity 2026
$3.50 Henry Hub (2026 avg)
[Start Learning][10] [The Process][11]

## What is Liquefied Natural Gas?

LNG is natural gas cooled to -162°C (-260°F), reducing its volume by 600 times for efficient
long-distance transport. Composed primarily of methane (CH4), LNG enables global energy trade
between continents, connecting gas-rich regions with energy-hungry markets.

### The Physics

Natural gas at -162°C becomes liquid, with 85-95% methane plus ethane, propane, and nitrogen. The
energy density enables transoceanic shipping.

[Learn the science →][12]

### The Infrastructure

From liquefaction trains to Q-Max carriers to regasification terminals, LNG requires specialized
cryogenic engineering at every stage.

[Explore technology →][13]

### The Markets

The USA, Qatar, and Australia dominate exports. Asia drives demand. Henry Hub, JKM, and TTF shape
pricing across interconnected global markets.

[View market data →][14]

## LNG by the Numbers

**85-95%** Methane (CH4) composition
**-260°F** Liquefaction temperature (-162°C)
**0.42 g/cm³** LNG density (45% of water)
**5-15%** Flammability range in air
**11.9 Bcf/d** US LNG exports (2024, world's largest)
**40%** Lower CO2 emissions vs. coal

## LNG vs. Pipeline Gas vs. CNG

────────────────┬─────────────────────────┬─────────────────────┬───────────────────────
Property        │LNG (Liquefied)          │Pipeline Gas         │CNG (Compressed)       
────────────────┼─────────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────
Temperature     │-162°C (-260°F)          │Ambient              │Ambient                
────────────────┼─────────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────
Pressure        │~1 bar (atmospheric)     │50-100 bar           │200-250 bar            
────────────────┼─────────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────
Volume Reduction│600:1                    │1:1                  │~200:1                 
────────────────┼─────────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────
Energy Density  │22.2 MJ/L                │0.034 MJ/L (at STP)  │9 MJ/L                 
────────────────┼─────────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────
Transport Method│Cryogenic tankers/trucks │Pipelines            │High-pressure cylinders
────────────────┼─────────────────────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────
Best Use Case   │Intercontinental shipping│Regional distribution│Vehicle fuel, off-grid 
────────────────┴─────────────────────────┴─────────────────────┴───────────────────────

**Key Insight:** LNG's 600:1 volume reduction makes it economically viable for transoceanic trade
where pipelines are impossible. A single Q-Max LNG carrier (266,000 m³) transports the energy
equivalent of 159 million cubic meters of gas at standard conditions.

## Global LNG Trade Flow

In 2026, the USA leads global LNG exports at 11.9 Bcf/d, followed by Australia and Qatar. Major
import regions include Asia (Japan, South Korea, China, India) and Europe (replacing Russian
pipeline gas).

### Top Exporters
1. **[United States][15]** — 11.9 Bcf/d (Sabine Pass, Cameron, Freeport, Golden Pass)
2. **[Australia][16]** — 10.5 Bcf/d (Gorgon, QCLNG, GLNG)
3. **[Qatar][17]** — 10.4 Bcf/d (Ras Laffan, North Field expansion ongoing)
4. **Russia** — 4.4 Bcf/d (Yamal LNG, Sakhalin-2)
5. **Malaysia** — 3.7 Bcf/d (MLNG Tiga, MLNG Dua)

### Top Importers
1. **China** — Post-Zero COVID demand surge
2. **Japan** — Largest historical importer
3. **South Korea** — Heavy industry reliance
4. **India** — Growing consumption
5. **European Union** — Energy security post-Russia

## Enabling a More Sustainable, Lower Carbon Future

Cheniere Energy, Inc. is the leading producer and exporter of liquefied natural gas (LNG) in the
United States and second largest producer of LNG globally, reliably providing a clean, secure, and
affordable solution to the growing global need for natural gas. Cheniere is a full-service LNG
provider, with capabilities that include gas procurement and transportation, liquefaction, vessel
chartering, and LNG delivery. Cheniere has one of the largest liquefaction platforms in the world,
consisting of the Sabine Pass and Corpus Christi liquefaction facilities on the U.S. Gulf Coast,
with total production capacity of approximately 45 million tonnes per annum of LNG in operation and
an additional 10+ million tonnes per annum of LNG under construction. Cheniere is also pursuing
liquefaction expansion opportunities and other projects along the LNG value chain. Cheniere is
headquartered in Houston, Texas, and has additional offices in London, Singapore, Beijing, Tokyo,
and Washington, D.C.

## Enabling a More Sustainable, Lower Carbon Future

Cheniere Energy, Inc. is the leading producer and exporter of liquefied natural gas (LNG) in the
United States and second largest producer of LNG globally, reliably providing a clean, secure, and
affordable solution to the growing global need for natural gas. Cheniere is a full-service LNG
provider, with capabilities that include gas procurement and transportation, liquefaction, vessel
chartering, and LNG delivery. Cheniere has one of the largest liquefaction platforms in the world,
consisting of the Sabine Pass and Corpus Christi liquefaction facilities on the U.S. Gulf Coast,
with total production capacity of approximately 45 million tonnes per annum of LNG in operation and
an additional 10+ million tonnes per annum of LNG under construction. Cheniere is also pursuing
liquefaction expansion opportunities and other projects along the LNG value chain. Cheniere is
headquartered in Houston, Texas, and has additional offices in London, Singapore, Beijing, Tokyo,
and Washington, D.C.

##### **Introduction**

“Maharashtra Natural Gas Limited (MNGL), a City Gas Distribution entity, is a joint venture of two
Maharatna PSUs, GAIL (India) Limited and Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) with equity
participation from Government of Maharashtra through MIDC and Indraprastha Gas Limited (IGL). 

MNGL is authorized by Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB) to Lay, Build, Operate &
Expand City Gas Distribution Project in the Geographical Areas of Pune & Pimpri-Chinchwad city
including adjoining areas of Hinjewadi, Chakan & Talegaon, Valsad (except area already authorized),
Dhule, Nashik District ,Sindhudurg District & Buldana, Nanded and Parbhani Districts in  Maharashtra
and Ramanagara District in Karnataka and Nizamabad, Adilabad, Nirmal, Mancherial Kumuram Bheem
Asifabad & Kamareddy Districts in Telangana.

MNGL started supply of Compressed Natural Gas in year 2008 during India’s first Commonwealth Youth
Games and from that auspicious beginning it stayed  true to its objective of providing clean,
environment friendly green fuel Compressed Natural Gas as an alternative to the conventional auto
fuels like Petrol and Diesel and safe, convenient, and reliable Piped Natural Gas to its customers
in the Domestic, Commercial, and Industrial sectors.”

###### Important


**TIPS TO STAY SAFE FROM FRAUD**

1. Do not click on links or download any app/QR code in messages claiming to be from MNGL and asking
for bill payment/Bill & KYC updation/to call back on a certain number to avoid disconnection etc.

2. Don't make Bill payment through any mode other than mentioned on the Invoice/bill i.e. through
website [https://www.mngl.in/pay-bill][130], Bharat Bill payment System BBPS, NACH/ECS, Cheque
deposit at Axis/ICICI Bank branches and MNGL Walk-in Centre's at Shivaji Nagar or Chinchwad in Pune
& Bhabha Nagar at Nashik.

3. Never share any personal information like bank details, OTPs, or account Numbers on call or
through Text messages.

4. In case you are unsure about a message, directly contact customer helpline No: 1800-266-2696 or
may visit official website of MNGL [https://www.mngl.in][131].

5. All official websites should have the protocol of https & not http. The additional 's' stands for
secure. So please look for the same while opening the official website links of MNGL.

6. Use strong passwords for online accounts.

7. Such instances of fraud may be reported to the nearest cyber police station or through the
website [https://cybercrime.gov.in][132]

###### Important


**TIPS TO STAY SAFE FROM FRAUD**

1. Do not click on links or download any app/QR code in messages claiming to be from MNGL and asking
for bill payment/Bill & KYC updation/to call back on a certain number to avoid disconnection etc.

2. Don't make Bill payment through any mode other than mentioned on the Invoice/bill i.e. through
website [https://www.mngl.in/pay-bill][130], Bharat Bill payment System BBPS, NACH/ECS, Cheque
deposit at Axis/ICICI Bank branches and MNGL Walk-in Centre's at Shivaji Nagar or Chinchwad in Pune
& Bhabha Nagar at Nashik.

3. Never share any personal information like bank details, OTPs, or account Numbers on call or
through Text messages.

4. In case you are unsure about a message, directly contact customer helpline No: 1800-266-2696 or
may visit official website of MNGL [https://www.mngl.in][131].

5. All official websites should have the protocol of https & not http. The additional 's' stands for
secure. So please look for the same while opening the official website links of MNGL.

6. Use strong passwords for online accounts.

7. Such instances of fraud may be reported to the nearest cyber police station or through the
website [https://cybercrime.gov.in][132]

### GLOBAL ENERGY OPERATOR

QatarEnergy LNG is a unique global energy operator in terms of size, service and reliability. We
operate 14 liquefied natural gas (LNG) trains with a total annual production capacity of 77 million
tonnes. This makes QatarEnergy LNG the largest LNG producer in the world. Established in 1984,
QatarEnergy LNG develops and produces hydrocarbons from the world’s largest non-associated natural
gas field. QatarEnergy LNG is committed to safety, environmental sustainability, flawless project
delivery, and the reliability and efficiency of our production facilities, to play a key role in
Qatar’s efforts to become a global leader in the LNG industry.

UGI Energy Services supplies and markets natural gas, liquid fuels, electricity, and renewable

A subsidiary of [UGI Corporation][60], we are a supplier, marketer, and midstream services provider
backed by over 140 years of [natural gas][61] experience, plus our own expanding energy
infrastructure.

UGIES is well-positioned to meet the changing energy demands of commercial, industrial,
institutional, and government customers for years to come.

# Marine Surveys.

Virtue Marine is your trusted partner in maritime solutions. With a comprehensive range of services
including ship technical management, marine surveys, maritime consultancy, and newbuilding
supervision, we are dedicated to ensuring the highest standards in providing tailored maritime
solutions for your Fleet.

 

Our expert team also specializes in bunker and draft surveys, and pre-purchase inspections,
providing thorough assessments and insights for potential ship buyers. 


Our ship inspections & marine surveys team provide coverage in Rotterdam, Antwerp, Ghent, Hamburg,
Amsterdam, Bremen, Terneuzen, Vlissingen (Flushing), Ijmuiden, Zeebrugge, Dunkirque & the entire ARA
region (Netherlands, Belgium & Germany).  


Let us be your trusted partner in navigating the complex waters of the maritime industry. With our
expertise, you can be sure to stay afloat and achieve success.

# Maritime Consultancy.
# 
# Ship Technical Management.
# 
# Ship NewBuilding Supervision.
# 
# Marine Surveys.

Virtue Marine is your trusted partner in maritime solutions. With a comprehensive range of services
including ship technical management, marine surveys, maritime consultancy, and newbuilding
supervision, we are dedicated to ensuring the highest standards in providing tailored maritime
solutions for your Fleet.

 

Our expert team also specializes in bunker and draft surveys, and pre-purchase inspections,
providing thorough assessments and insights for potential ship buyers. 


Our ship inspections & marine surveys team provide coverage in Rotterdam, Antwerp, Ghent, Hamburg,
Amsterdam, Bremen, Terneuzen, Vlissingen (Flushing), Ijmuiden, Zeebrugge, Dunkirque & the entire ARA
region (Netherlands, Belgium & Germany).  


Let us be your trusted partner in navigating the complex waters of the maritime industry. With our
expertise, you can be sure to stay afloat and achieve success.

## what can we do for you..?

Certified Marine Surveyors

[read more ][12]

## [Ship New Building Supervision][13]

Independent Site Teams & Owner’s Representation


We manage new building constructions from A to Z.

[read more ][14]
[EU Flag.png]

## [FuelEU Compliancy][15]

Stop Subsidizing the EU !


If your fleet is operating at a deficit, paying the statutory penalty in June does nothing to fix
your exposure for the following year. Virtue Marine provides FuelEU Vulnerability Audits & roadmaps
to eliminate your GHG deficits.

[read more ][16]

Virtue Marine has been an invaluable partner in ensuring our fleet remains compliant and seaworthy.
Their ship marine surveys are incredibly thorough, and their expertise helped us identify and

detail set them apart in the industry.

significantly improved our fleet’s operational efficiency and compliance.

# Westport Fuel Systems

## The global leader in alternative fuel solutions

## Innovative, high-quality solutions that meet strict emission standards.

Our global team develops and supplies advanced LPG, CNG, LNG, and H2 systems and components for OEM,
DOEM, and AM sectors worldwide. Our main customers operate in the automotive sector, but also in
transportation, off-road vehicles, electronics, alternative fuel storage, and motor racing. They
test innovative, high-quality solutions that meet strict emission standards.

# Westport Fuel Systems

## The global leader in alternative fuel solutions

# Westport Fuel Systems

## The global leader in alternative fuel solutions

## Innovative, high-quality solutions that meet strict emission standards.

Our global team develops and supplies advanced LPG, CNG, LNG, and H2 systems and components for OEM,
DOEM, and AM sectors worldwide. Our main customers operate in the automotive sector, but also in
transportation, off-road vehicles, electronics, alternative fuel storage, and motor racing. They
test innovative, high-quality solutions that meet strict emission standards.
